parent_measurement.convention: frame.py (b), actual union parents split equally; parent slots outside union stay own; no slots use oldest union adult relative, else own
parent_measurement.uncertainty: SDR sampling only; modeled age denominator held fixed. Excludes misreporting, coverage, loss model, age-mix uncertainty and the policy for the modeled unlinked remainder.
parent_measurement.unlinked_historical_rule: The modeled remainder stays G3plus; no parental observation is invented.
parent_measurement.historical_observed_definition: Civilian native (PRCITSHP 1-3) under 18, outside canonical union, not (PEHSPNON=1 and PRDTHSP=1), with at least one linked canonical-union G2 parent; every present linked parent's own PENATVTY in US_AREAS. All parent types, as frame.py (b).

reviewer_definition_replay.definition: All present linked parents US-area-born; at least one canonical union G2 parent; native civilian minor outside union; not PEHSPNON=1 and PRDTHSP=1. Does not require own recorded parental birthplaces US-area-born.

age_source_consistency_screen.definition: Both child-recorded parental birthplace fields US-area-born AND every present linked parent's own birthplace US-area-born (measure_loss.py/classify screen).

source_definition_trace.count: population.py -> identity_loss_propagation/propagate.py pop_p3 -> bounds_coverage_fiscal.py -> dt_replication.py: linked parent own birthplace plus grandparent birthplace; calibration two biological parents
source_definition_trace.age: age_mix.py -> measure_loss.py CLASSIFY_SQL -> g3_identity_pooled/analyze.py classify: both own parental birthplaces US and present linked parents US
source_definition_trace.interpretation: Central follows the count caller's principal linked-parent own birthplace for directly observed ancestry. The stricter age caller intersection and child-recorded birthplace-only definition are misreporting sensitivities. All present linked parent types participate in NAS convention(b), whose routing comes unchanged from frame.py; the count calibration's two-biological-parent restriction is not a routing restriction.

parent_measurement.propagated_rule: Original canonical union retains frozen P7 parent/state/credit routing; new reporters/native children take frame.py(b) on completed observed membership. This is a declared composite vintage, not a full completed-frame replay.
parent_measurement.existing_union_rebuild_deferral: Six original minor assignments change under a full completed frame; their exact rows/161 weights/net changes are retained beside. Parent defers coordinated parent/state/credit rebuild to preserve frozen P7 inputs.
